title: Area Sales Manager - SME Lending
jobDescription:
About the Business
OXYZO Financial Services Ltd. is a Leading Fintech NBFC headquartered in Gurugram. We are into B2B Lending and cover both SME and Emerging Corporate customers Pan-India having our offices spread across 20+ cities in India including NCR, Chandigarh, Jaipur, Indore, Ahmedabad, Mumbai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata, etc.
OXYZO is a part of the OfBusiness Group and was incorporated in 2016- having already built an AUM (Asset Under Management) of 10,000 Cr+ with a PAT of 370 Cr+ last year and is growing year on year with well established processes and governance framework with marque investors including Creation Investments, Matrix Partners, Norwest, Tiger Global and Alpha Wave.
What you will do.
1. Actively sourcing and acquiring SME and Mid Corporate clients across a spectrum of industries including Manufacturing, Engineering, Chemicals, Pharma, Textiles, and Logistics.
2. Conducting thorough credit and risk analyses to inform sound decision-making, while adeptly preparing credit notes to facilitate smooth deal structuring.
3. Ensuring seamless document fulfillment and timely disbursement of credit facilities
4. Working alongside the leadership and risk team to structure competitive deals and onboard clients effectively.
5. Collaborating with the leadership to identify and capitalize on new growth clusters and industries
6. Building and leveraging a strong network within industry circles to expand the business portfolio and capitalize on emerging prospects.
What we are looking for.
1–4 years of experience in Business Development / Sales (Banking, NBFC, or Financial Services preferred)
Strong interest in working with SMEs & Emerging Corporates across diverse industries
Basic understanding of credit, risk analysis, and financial documents
Excellent communication and relationship-building skills
Self-driven, with the ability to identify growth opportunities and build networks
Eagerness to learn and collaborate with leadership on deal structuring and client onboarding
What we are offering.
1. Industry best internal growth and progression (in terms of Grade/Wealth/Team/Learnings) with one of India's biggest and fastest growing NBFCs
2. Opportunity to work alongside and learn from some of the best commercial stalwarts
3. Competitive Pay & Benefits
4. Meritocratic and Rewarding Environment
5. Opportunity to do unconventional lending products with distinct USPs (Best TAT, Broader Client Coverage, Higher Risk Appetite, Superior Client Experience, etc.)

title: Zonal Head - Employee Relations (West)
jobDescription:
About the Business
At Oxyzo, we specialize in providing custom credit solutions catered to the needs of Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs). Our services are designed to help SMEs expand operations, increase revenue, and boost profit margins. Our offerings include low-interest rates, collateral-free credit, and quick loan processing, making Oxyzo a preferred lending option for SMEs in India. Currently, we serve thousands of SMEs, with an AUM (Asset Under Management) of 8,400 Cr with a PAT of 360 Cr last year and is growing year on year with well-established processes.
What you will do.
We’re looking for a dynamic and people-focused Zonal Head – HR (West) to be based at Mumbai
to lead Employee Relations and Engagement
across our West region. This role is central to fostering a positive, transparent, and high-performance culture while partnering closely with business leaders.
Key Responsibilities
Drive employee relations strategy
aligned with business and culture.
Act as a trusted advisor
for grievances, disciplinary matters, and workplace issues.
Conduct ER diagnostics, pulse checks, and engagement audits
to address concerns proactively.
Lead regional engagement initiatives, events, and employee connect programs
.
Build capability among managers on progressive ER practices and culture leadership
.
Partner with leadership on attrition insights, people analytics, and retention actions
.
What we are looking for.
5–7 years of HR experience with strong focus on Employee Relations / HRBP / Engagement
.
Excellent interpersonal and influencing skills with a balanced, empathetic approach.
Experience managing multi-location teams (preferably in BFSI / Fintech).
MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or equivalent.
What we are offering.
Real Impact from Day One
Hyper-Growth Environment
Empowered Leadership
Learning & Growth
People-First Culture
